name: modal-close-centering
goal: Close icons stay visually centered in shared report dialogs on desktop, mobile and portable reports

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Published Verification modal uses a centered text box whose multiplication glyph paints 2 pixels below center. Expected shared close icon paints within 1 pixel of center at desktop and mobile sizes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing modal-detail tests prove opening, Escape and focus, but never painted icon alignment. Extend those same desktop/mobile cases with pixel-bound centering and close-button interaction.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: /tmp/harness-modal-red.log: both unchanged standard modal cases fail with painted center offset 2 (limit 1). Before captures are under packages/reports/output/evidence/modal-before.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared Modal reuses HarnessIcon close; grid-centered 44px square button removes font baseline dependence while retaining labels and handlers.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: /tmp/harness-modal-green.log: same unchanged desktop/mobile cases pass all three detail modals and close/Escape/focus interactions. Inspected after images show centered shared icon.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports bun run check passes: formatting, zero Svelte diagnostics, lint, 551 tests, builds and audit. Two focused portable browser cases pass; fresh screenshots inspected. Local file preview in Codex browser is policy-blocked; live report preview will be checked separately.
